name: Chili Pepper
hook: Chili flowers dropping off? Your pot is drying out.

steps.title: Your sunniest spot
steps.tip: A sunny windowsill, balcony or patio. Chilies need lots of sun to fruit well.

steps.title: Outdoors above 12°C at night
steps.tip: Keep it indoors until nights stay above 12°C. It grows best above 15°C; above 30°C, it sets less fruit.

steps.title: Keep it evenly moist
steps.tip: Dry soil makes flower buds drop. In hot weather, pots may need water every day.

steps.title: One plant per 22 cm pot
steps.tip: Use peat-free all-purpose potting mix, one plant per 22 cm pot, and stakes to support big plants.

steps.title: Feed weekly once it flowers
steps.tip: As soon as flowers appear, give a high-potassium liquid fertilizer every week.

steps.title: Watch for aphids and mites
steps.tip: Indoors, check for aphids, spider mites and whitefly. Wear gloves when picking hot chilies.

outro: Sun, warmth and steady water: a pot of chilies on your windowsill.

sources.title: RHS: How to grow chilli peppers

faqs.question: Can I keep my chili plant over winter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Move it somewhere heated, prune it to a manageable size, keep it warm and bright, and water only a little until spring.
